question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

**Carry**
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (1) i.e. "Leave".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

 
• **Carry: (ले जाना)** - To hold and take from one place to another.

 
 
• **Example**: He carried the boxes out to the truck.
